fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of "msdt.exe" using an answer file which is simulating the legitimate way of calling msdt via "pcwrun.exe" (For example from the compatibility tab).
fields.name: MSDT Execution Via Answer File
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\msdt.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\WINDOWS\\diagnostics\\index\\PCWDiagnostic.xml" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -af " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " /af " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " –af " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " —af " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " ―af ")) and (not src.process.image.path contains "\\pcwrun.exe")))
